Interface PlayerRegionApi

public interface PlayerRegionApi
Entry point of the player region service.

Obtain it from Bukkit's services manager in onEnable: 

PlayerRegionApi api = getServer().getServicesManager().load(PlayerRegionApi.class);
PlayerRegionSubscription sub = api.subscribe(this, 128);

This interface only hands out subscriptions. All player queries go through the PlayerRegionSubscription it returns. Main thread only.

    • subscribe

      PlayerRegionSubscription subscribe(org.bukkit.plugin.Plugin owner, int cellSize)
      Subscribes to the player grid at the given resolution.

      The cell size is a power of two. Every subscriber of the same resolution shares one grid, which is refreshed once per second while at least one subscription to it is open. The returned handle can only query its own resolution, so subscribe separately for each cell size you need.

      Close the returned handle when you are done with it, typically in onDisable. Subscriptions owned by a plugin that gets disabled are closed automatically.

      Parameters:
      owner - the plugin that owns the subscription; used for cleanup and diagnostics
      cellSize - requested cell edge length in blocks; must be at least 16 and n^2
      Returns:
      a new subscription handle, never null
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if cellSize is less than 16 or not n^2
